rows.translation_en:
Don't be shy! Put me, Itsuka,

rows.translation_en:
A heavenly maiden
fell in love with a mortal man.
That was how it all began.
rows.context: Home menu/help, settings, or opening narration as identified by the source file.

rows.translation_en:
Under repeated attacks
by oni, the capital, Kyoto,
was sinking into ruin.
rows.context: Home menu/help, settings, or opening narration as identified by the source file.

rows.translation_en: The oni leader's name was Shutendoji.
rows.context: Home menu/help, settings, or opening narration as identified by the source file.

Renowned warriors marched to slay him,
but every one was struck down,
leaving only heaps of corpses.

rows.translation_en:

had taken up the challenge and were
at last about to work a miracle.

rows.translation_en: It's a pleasure to meet you, %$!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
I'm Itsuka, and starting today,
I'll be looking after you.
I'm so glad to be here!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Well, never catching a cold is about
my only strong point, so don't hold back!
Just say the word, and I'll get cracking!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
And let's work together
to bring down Shutendoji
as soon as we can!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Now then, off you go
to hunt some oni!!
May fortune favor you in battle!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en: Time to set out!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
...But first, equip your swords and armor,
get all your items ready, and make sure
you haven't forgotten anything!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.

rows.translation_en:
If some words or numbers
don't make sense yet,
don't get bogged down in the details!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Right now, you just have to fight, fight, fight
and build up your strength. That's all you can do.
The little details can wait!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Once you're ready,
give that "Sortie" order for real this time!
Let's start things off with a bang!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. First arrival: greeting the clan head and explaining sortie preparation.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
%$!! When you saw Lady Hiruko's face
at the recent Rite of Divine Union,
you must have had quite a shock!?
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
"Itsuka was actually... none other than
Hiruko Taishoten, ruler of heaven!!
I've been fooled!!"
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.
Itsuka voices an imagined reaction from the clan head; quotation marks clarify the shift.

rows.translation_en:
...Just kidding! Hehe.
Pretty good resemblance, right?
It takes work to look this convincing!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
I've always admired Lady Hiruko,
so I've studied everything from her hairstyle
to her voice, and copied it as best I can.
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Besides, why would the greatest deity of all
be here chopping radishes
and washing loincloths!?
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Still, if you want to keep
mistaking me for Lady Hiruko, go ahead.
I'd be very flattered!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After meeting Hiruko: Itsuka jokes about the resemblance; lines 12-13 are mock surprise.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
Um... %$,
could we have a little talk...?
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.
Intentional source trailing fragment retained; inspect adjacent rows.

rows.translation_en:
Are you having trouble trusting heaven
after being kept in the dark
about the real Shutendoji?
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
I'm not clever enough to understand
all the complicated parts, but...
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.
Intentional source trailing fragment retained; inspect adjacent rows.

rows.translation_en:
Even if it meant risking Shuten's release,
rescuing the captive deities
while we had the chance...
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
I believe Lady Hiruko decided
that it would strengthen
the %@ clan in the long run!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
She must have that much faith
in the %@ clan!
So have a little more faith in yourselves!!
rows.context: Itsuka speaks respectfully and conversationally to the player-selected clan head. After learning about the real Shutendoji: Itsuka defends the decision to free captive deities.
review_notes: No gender inferred for the clan head or runtime family members.

rows.translation_en:
